description: This file defines the Cotangent class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing various trigonometric functions including cotangent, hyperbolic cotangent, arccotangent, and their hyperbolic counterparts. It handles both scalar and array inputs and manages exceptions for invalid inputs.

classes.name: Cotangent
classes.description: Provides static methods to calculate cotangent, hyperbolic cotangent, arccotangent, and hyperbolic arccotangent, handling both scalar and array inputs.

methods.name: cot
methods.description: Calculates the cotangent of an angle, supports array inputs, returns the cotangent or an array of cotangents.

methods.name: coth
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic cotangent of an angle, supports array inputs, returns the hyperbolic cotangent or an array.

methods.name: acot
methods.description: Calculates the arccotangent of a number, supports array inputs, returns the arccotangent or an array.

methods.name: acoth
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic arccotangent of a number, supports array inputs, returns the hyperbolic arccotangent or an array.
